questions.stem: At which position of the coil in an AC generator is the induced voltage at its maximum?

options.text: When the coil is horizontal (parallel to the field)
When the coil is vertical (perpendicular to the field)
When the coil is at 45 degrees to the field
The voltage is the same at all positions

questions.explanation: The induced voltage is maximum when the coil is horizontal (parallel to the magnetic field lines). At this position, the coil sides are cutting through field lines at the greatest rate. When the coil is vertical, the sides move parallel to the field lines and the induced voltage is zero.
